newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ALFONSO LEADS SPAIN TO EASY WIN OVER MALTA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ALFONSO LEADS SPAIN TO EASY WIN OVER MALTA.

text.p: Spain went four points clear at the top of Group Six when striker Alfonso Perez scored twice to lead them to a comfortable 4-0 win over Malta in their World Cup qualifying match on Wednesday.
It put Spain on 16 points from six matches, four ahead of Yugoslavia who have a game in hand.
But in a group that could easily be decided on goal difference, the Spaniards will know they should have emerged with a better scoreline from a game they dominated from start to finish.
Third placed Slovakia are seven points behind Spain but have two matches in hand.
Josep Guardiola opened the scoring for Spain in the 25th minute after latching onto a pass from Raul Gonzalez.
Alfonso blasted home a loose ball shortly before half-time, and tapped in the third after a defensive mistake less than a minute after the break.
After missing chances to go further ahead, Spain finally scored again thanks to a last-minute effort by Juan Pizzi.
